In [[44 BBY/Legends|44 BBY]], the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Tahl]] undertook a '''mission''' to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Melida/Daan/Legends|Melida/Daan]] in an attempt to negotiate a peace settlement and end the centuries-long [[Melida/Daan Civil War|civil war]] between the [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] [[Melida/Legends|Melida]] and [[Daan (people)/Legends|Daan]] tribes. The mission failed when war broke out again and Tahl was captured by the Melida and wounded, necessitating a [[Mission to Melida/Daan|rescue mission]] by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]].
